conectar.intro: Plania **doesn't make you migrate anything**: it points to the database you already use and auto-detects the columns. Supported engines: PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle and SQLite — or upload a CSV/Excel exported from your ERP (Zureo, Memory, Tango, Bejerman, Odoo, SAP B1 and similar).

ayuda.cuerpo:
**What does Plania do?** It connects to your ERP or database (no migration needed), analyzes stock, prices, margins, zones and customers, and returns actionable decisions: offers, restocking, price adjustments, delivery routes and customers to win back — all exportable to **PDF, Word and Excel** and queryable by chat with the **Copilot**.

**First steps**
1.  *Connect ERP / Database*: point to your database (or try the included demo).
2.  *Offers & Suggestions*: export the full report for the day.
3.  *Copilot*: ask in plain language — «what should I restock now?».

**7-day trial** — everything enabled, no card required. When it expires, your data isn't touched: activate your license and pick up where you left off.

**Support** — soporte@plania.uy · WhatsApp +598 99 000 000

copiloto.ofertas_sin_datos: No products with relevant overstock: stock levels are healthy.
copiloto.ofertas_sin_datos_filtro: No offers to run for {filtro}: none of it is overstocked today. Ask "what offers should I run this week?" to see every category.
copiloto.ofertas_resumen: There are {n} products with overstock tying up ${capital}. I suggest discounts of {min_desc}% to {max_desc}% (always above the cost+8% floor). The 3 most urgent: {lista}.
copiloto.reposicion_sin_datos: No stockout risk at the current turnover rate.
copiloto.reposicion_sin_datos_filtro: Nothing urgent to restock in {filtro}: days of stock cover the lead time.
copiloto.reposicion_resumen: There are {n} products at risk of running out (${venta_riesgo}/month of sales at stake). Suggested investment: ${inversion}. Most urgent: {nombre} ({dias_stock} days of stock, supplier takes {lead_time_dias} days).
copiloto.precio_producto: {nombre}: price ${precio}, cost ${costo} (margin {margen}%). It sold {unidades} units this period with a real margin of {margen_real}%.
copiloto.precios_sin_subas: Margins are in line with their category; no obvious increases to make.
copiloto.precios_sin_subas_filtro: No price increases suggested for {filtro}: those margins are already in line with their category.
copiloto.precios_resumen: There are {n} products with margin below their category. Adjusting them adds ${extra}/month without touching volume. Biggest impact: {nombre} (from ${precio} to ${sugerido}).
copiloto.margenes_resumen: Weighted average margin: {promedio}%. Showing the {n} products with {orden} sales/margin.
copiloto.stock_general_resumen: Total stock: {total} units across {n} SKUs, valued at ${valor} at cost. {quiebres} stockouts and {sobrestock} products with more than 90 days of stock.
copiloto.stock_varios: I found {n} matching products: totaling {total} units.
copiloto.zonas_sin_datos: The connected data doesn't include customer zone/department.
copiloto.zonas_resumen: The best-selling {dim} is {top} (${venta_top}, margin {margen_top}%) and the weakest is {bottom} (${venta_bottom}).{extra}
copiloto.zonas_extra_oportunidades: I detected {n} cross-selling opportunities by zone (${potencial} potential).
copiloto.tipo_negocio_sin_datos: The connected data doesn't include customer business type.
copiloto.tipo_negocio_resumen: By business type: {tipo} leads with ${venta} ({n} customers). The best margin is left by {tipo_margen} ({margen}%).
copiloto.proveedores_sin_datos: The connected data doesn't include supplier.
copiloto.proveedores_resumen: Your main supplier is {proveedor} (${venta} in associated sales, margin {margen}%).{urgente}
copiloto.proveedores_urgente: Heads up: the most urgent order is to {proveedor} (${compra} of suggested purchase).
copiloto.venta_producto_resumen: {sujeto} sold {unidades} units for ${venta} in the period.{extra}
copiloto.clientes_resumen: There are {n} customers who stopped buying; they were worth ${venta}. Prioritize: {lista}.
copiloto.clientes_top_resumen: Your {n} best customers account for ${venta}. The top one places {pedidos} orders worth ${venta_top}.
copiloto.tendencia_resumen: Last month: ${venta} ({delta}% vs the previous one), margin {margen}%.
copiloto.ventas_resumen: Last 30 days: ${venta} in sales, margin {margen}% (${margen_monto}), {n} active customers. Best seller: {nombre} (${venta_top}).
copiloto.fallback_resumen: I can answer about stock, prices, margins, offers, restocking, zones, business types and customers. Meanwhile, today's summary: ${capital} tied up in overstock, ${riesgo} in sales at risk from stockouts, ${extra}/month of recoverable margin from price adjustments. Ask me, for example: «what offers should I run this week?», «what should I restock now?», «which zone is underperforming?».
exportes.texto_ofertas: Products with excess stock: the suggested discount speeds up turnover without breaking the cost+8% floor.
exportes.texto_reposicion: Products whose stock won't cover the supplier's lead time: suggested quantity for 30 days of sales.
exportes.texto_precios: Products with margin below their category; the suggested increase aligns the margin without pricing out of the market.
exportes.texto_zonas: Cross-selling detected: categories that businesses of the same type buy in other zones and not here yet.
exportes.texto_recupero: Customers with a purchase history who stopped ordering, ranked by what they were worth.
